ranking: CA/OLD_CA: remote token-rank packet reduction, then max-rank row reduction. LA: max-rank row reduction, then packets. Exact features, no latency prediction or speed claim.
cold_prefill_cache_equivalence: Each layer is encountered once from empty cache; all current-layer experts are mandatory misses. Capacity changes victim slots, not current-layer demand/placement. Both cache sizes validated by generic48-layer replay on workload0 for both batches and all4 policies.
seed_activity: Candidates deterministic; their placement seed inactive. BR admission assignment is seeded, so the paired BR-relative seed axis remains active.
